archivedStories.title: Peter Pan · 旧简写版
archivedStories.synopsis: 飞往梦幻岛，面对海盗，也面对一个选择：永远不长大，还是回到爱你的人身边。
archivedStories.credits: 原著：J. M. Barrie；原版插画：F. D. Bedford。采用 Project Gutenberg 原版。本站简明英文改写与中文翻译为新编，CC BY 4.0；不代表原著全文，也没有正式蓝思测评。
archivedStories.translationNote: 12 章完整主要故事线的节选改写；采用常用词和短句，保留成长与选择。

picturePages.text: Peter Pan.

sentences.en: Peter Pan.
sentences.zh: 彼得潘：简明英文改写版。

picturePages.text: Chapter 1: The Open Window. Wendy Darling lived in London with her brothers, John and Michael. Their dog, Nana, helped look after them.

sentences.en: Chapter 1: The Open Window.
sentences.zh: 第1章：打开的窗户。

sentences.en: Wendy Darling lived in London with her brothers, John and Michael.
sentences.zh: 温蒂·达林和弟弟约翰、迈克尔住在伦敦。

sentences.en: Their dog, Nana, helped look after them.
sentences.zh: 他们的狗娜娜帮忙照顾他们。

picturePages.text: At night, Wendy told stories about a boy called Peter Pan. He could fly, and he did not want to grow up. One night, Peter came through the bedroom window.

sentences.en: At night, Wendy told stories about a boy called Peter Pan.
sentences.zh: 晚上，温蒂会讲一个叫彼得·潘的男孩的故事。

sentences.en: He could fly, and he did not want to grow up.
sentences.zh: 他会飞，而且不想长大。

sentences.en: One night, Peter came through the bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，彼得从卧室的窗户飞了进来。

picturePages.text: A tiny fairy called Tinker Bell came with him. Peter was looking for his shadow. Nana had caught it when he visited the room before.

sentences.en: A tiny fairy called Tinker Bell came with him.
sentences.zh: 一个叫叮当的小仙女和他一起来了。

sentences.en: Peter was looking for his shadow.
sentences.zh: 彼得在找自己的影子。

sentences.en: Nana had caught it when he visited the room before.
sentences.zh: 他上次来这个房间时，娜娜抓住了他的影子。

picturePages.text: He found it, but he could not join it to his feet. Wendy woke up and saw him crying on the floor. She carefully sewed his shadow back on.

sentences.en: He found it, but he could not join it to his feet.
sentences.zh: 他找到了影子，却没法把它接到自己的脚上。

sentences.en: Wendy woke up and saw him crying on the floor.
sentences.zh: 温蒂醒来，看见他坐在地板上哭。

sentences.en: She carefully sewed his shadow back on.
sentences.zh: 她小心地把他的影子缝了回去。

picturePages.text: Peter jumped up and said that he had done it himself. Wendy was hurt, and he quickly tried to make her smile. They gave each other small gifts.

sentences.en: Peter jumped up and said that he had done it himself.
sentences.zh: 彼得跳起来，说这是他自己做好的。

sentences.en: Wendy was hurt, and he quickly tried to make her smile.
sentences.zh: 温蒂有些伤心，他赶紧想办法逗她开心。

sentences.en: They gave each other small gifts.
sentences.zh: 他们交换了小礼物。

picturePages.text: Peter gave Wendy an acorn button, which she wore on a chain. Then he told her about an island called Neverland. The Lost Boys lived there, but they had no one to tell them stories.

sentences.en: Peter gave Wendy an acorn button, which she wore on a chain.
sentences.zh: 彼得送给温蒂一颗橡子纽扣，她把它挂在链子上戴着。

sentences.en: Then he told her about an island called Neverland.
sentences.zh: 然后，他告诉她有一座叫梦幻岛的岛。

sentences.en: The Lost Boys lived there, but they had no one to tell them stories.
sentences.zh: 迷失男孩们住在那里，却没有人给他们讲故事。

picturePages.text: Peter asked Wendy to come with him.

sentences.en: Peter asked Wendy to come with him.
sentences.zh: 彼得邀请温蒂和他一起去。

picturePages.text: Chapter 2: Across the Night Sky. Wendy wanted an adventure, but she would not leave her brothers behind. Peter agreed to take all three children.

sentences.en: Chapter 2: Across the Night Sky.
sentences.zh: 第2章：飞越夜空。

sentences.en: Wendy wanted an adventure, but she would not leave her brothers behind.
sentences.zh: 温蒂想去冒险，但她不肯丢下两个弟弟。

sentences.en: Peter agreed to take all three children.
sentences.zh: 彼得同意把三个孩子都带上。

picturePages.text: He taught them to think happy thoughts. Tinker Bell gave them fairy dust, and their feet left the floor. Soon they were flying above the roofs of London.

sentences.en: He taught them to think happy thoughts.
sentences.zh: 他教他们想着快乐的事情。

sentences.en: Tinker Bell gave them fairy dust, and their feet left the floor.
sentences.zh: 叮当给他们撒上仙尘，他们的脚便离开了地板。

sentences.en: Soon they were flying above the roofs of London.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们就飞到了伦敦的屋顶上方。

picturePages.text: The streets below looked like thin lines of light. Wendy felt excited when the city disappeared behind them. They flew over the sea for a long time.

sentences.en: The streets below looked like thin lines of light.
sentences.zh: 下面的街道看起来像一条条细细的光线。

sentences.en: Wendy felt excited when the city disappeared behind them.
sentences.zh: 城市消失在身后时，温蒂感到十分兴奋。

sentences.en: They flew over the sea for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们在海上飞了很久。

picturePages.text: The children became tired and hungry, but Peter kept playing. Sometimes he flew away and almost forgot to come back. Wendy began to see that flying was easier for him than caring for others.

sentences.en: The children became tired and hungry, but Peter kept playing.
sentences.zh: 孩子们又累又饿，彼得却一直在玩。

sentences.en: Sometimes he flew away and almost forgot to come back.
sentences.zh: 有时他飞走了，几乎忘了回来。

sentences.en: Wendy began to see that flying was easier for him than caring for others.
sentences.zh: 温蒂渐渐发现，对他来说，飞行比照顾别人容易。

picturePages.text: At last, dark trees and bright water appeared below. There were mountains, a small lake, and a pirate ship. The island looked like a dream that had become real.

sentences.en: At last, dark trees and bright water appeared below.
sentences.zh: 终于，下面出现了深色的树林和明亮的水面。

sentences.en: There were mountains, a small lake, and a pirate ship.
sentences.zh: 那里有山、一片小湖，还有一艘海盗船。

sentences.en: The island looked like a dream that had become real.
sentences.zh: 这座岛仿佛是一个变成了现实的梦。

picturePages.text: Then a gun fired from the ship. The children rushed into the clouds and lost sight of one another. Tinker Bell offered to guide Wendy to a safe place.

sentences.en: Then a gun fired from the ship.
sentences.zh: 突然，船上开了一炮。

sentences.en: The children rushed into the clouds and lost sight of one another.
sentences.zh: 孩子们冲进云层，彼此看不见了。

sentences.en: Tinker Bell offered to guide Wendy to a safe place.
sentences.zh: 叮当说可以带温蒂去一个安全的地方。

picturePages.text: Wendy followed her little light toward the trees.

sentences.en: Wendy followed her little light toward the trees.
sentences.zh: 温蒂跟着她小小的光，朝树林飞去。

picturePages.text: Chapter 3: The Arrow in the Forest. Tinker Bell was jealous because Peter liked talking to Wendy. She flew ahead and found the Lost Boys.

sentences.en: Chapter 3: The Arrow in the Forest.
sentences.zh: 第3章：森林中的箭。

sentences.en: Tinker Bell was jealous because Peter liked talking to Wendy.
sentences.zh: 叮当很嫉妒，因为彼得喜欢和温蒂说话。

sentences.en: She flew ahead and found the Lost Boys.
sentences.zh: 她飞到前面，找到了迷失男孩们。

picturePages.text: She told them that Peter wanted them to shoot the strange flying girl. One boy, Tootles, believed her and let an arrow fly. Wendy fell to the ground, and the boys hurried toward her.

sentences.en: She told them that Peter wanted them to shoot the strange flying girl.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们，彼得要他们射下那个陌生的飞行女孩。

sentences.en: One boy, Tootles, believed her and let an arrow fly.
sentences.zh: 一个叫图图的男孩相信了她，射出了一支箭。

sentences.en: Wendy fell to the ground, and the boys hurried toward her.
sentences.zh: 温蒂摔到地上，男孩们赶紧跑向她。

picturePages.text: When Peter arrived, he was angry and afraid. Then he saw the acorn button hanging from Wendy's chain. The arrow had struck the button instead of her heart.

sentences.en: When Peter arrived, he was angry and afraid.
sentences.zh: 彼得赶到时，又生气又害怕。

sentences.en: Then he saw the acorn button hanging from Wendy's chain.
sentences.zh: 接着，他看到了温蒂链子上挂着的橡子纽扣。

sentences.en: The arrow had struck the button instead of her heart.
sentences.zh: 箭射中了纽扣，没有射中她的心脏。

picturePages.text: Wendy was alive, and she slowly opened her eyes. Tootles was sorry and offered Peter his life. Wendy stopped Peter from hurting him.

sentences.en: Wendy was alive, and she slowly opened her eyes.
sentences.zh: 温蒂还活着，她慢慢睁开了眼睛。

sentences.en: Tootles was sorry and offered Peter his life.
sentences.zh: 图图十分后悔，愿意让彼得处罚自己，甚至夺去生命。

sentences.en: Wendy stopped Peter from hurting him.
sentences.zh: 温蒂阻止了彼得伤害他。

picturePages.text: Peter sent Tinker Bell away for a time because of her cruel trick. The boys built a small house around Wendy while she rested. They hoped that she would stay and look after them.

sentences.en: Peter sent Tinker Bell away for a time because of her cruel trick.
sentences.zh: 因为叮当的残忍恶作剧，彼得暂时把她赶走了。

sentences.en: The boys built a small house around Wendy while she rested.
sentences.zh: 温蒂休息时，男孩们围着她搭起了一座小屋。

sentences.en: They hoped that she would stay and look after them.
sentences.zh: 他们希望她留下来照顾他们。

picturePages.text: Wendy said she was only a girl and did not know much about being a mother. The boys said that she already knew more than they did. Peter stood outside with his sword and kept watch.

sentences.en: Wendy said she was only a girl and did not know much about being a mother.
sentences.zh: 温蒂说自己只是个女孩，不太懂得怎样当妈妈。

sentences.en: The boys said that she already knew more than they did.
sentences.zh: 男孩们说，她已经比他们懂得多了。

sentences.en: Peter stood outside with his sword and kept watch.
sentences.zh: 彼得拿着剑站在外面守卫。

picturePages.text: For that night, Wendy and her brothers were safe.

sentences.en: For that night, Wendy and her brothers were safe.
sentences.zh: 至少这一夜，温蒂和弟弟们是安全的。

picturePages.text: Chapter 4: A Home Under the Ground. The children moved into a secret home under the ground. Each boy climbed down through a hole inside a tree.

sentences.en: Chapter 4: A Home Under the Ground.
sentences.zh: 第4章：地下的家。

sentences.en: The children moved into a secret home under the ground.
sentences.zh: 孩子们搬进了一个秘密的地下家园。

sentences.en: Each boy climbed down through a hole inside a tree.
sentences.zh: 每个男孩都从树里的洞爬下去。

picturePages.text: There was a table, a warm fire, and a large bed. Tinker Bell had a tiny room of her own. Wendy told stories and helped the boys mend their clothes.

sentences.en: There was a table, a warm fire, and a large bed.
sentences.zh: 里面有一张桌子、一堆温暖的炉火和一张大床。

sentences.en: Tinker Bell had a tiny room of her own.
sentences.zh: 叮当有一间属于自己的小房间。

sentences.en: Wendy told stories and helped the boys mend their clothes.
sentences.zh: 温蒂讲故事，还帮男孩们修补衣服。

picturePages.text: John and Michael joined the games and quickly felt at home. Sometimes the children pretended to have a wonderful dinner. Peter enjoyed the game even when there was little real food.

sentences.en: John and Michael joined the games and quickly felt at home.
sentences.zh: 约翰和迈克尔加入了游戏，很快就觉得像在家里一样。

sentences.en: Sometimes the children pretended to have a wonderful dinner.
sentences.zh: 有时，孩子们假装在吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。

sentences.en: Peter enjoyed the game even when there was little real food.
sentences.zh: 即使真正的食物不多，彼得也玩得很开心。

picturePages.text: He called himself their father, but he meant it only as a game. Wendy sometimes wished he could understand her feelings more clearly. Peter was brave and full of ideas, but he could be careless.

sentences.en: He called himself their father, but he meant it only as a game.
sentences.zh: 他称自己是他们的父亲，但这只是游戏里的角色。

sentences.en: Wendy sometimes wished he could understand her feelings more clearly.
sentences.zh: 温蒂有时希望他能更明白自己的感受。

sentences.en: Peter was brave and full of ideas, but he could be careless.
sentences.zh: 彼得很勇敢，点子很多，但他也会粗心。

picturePages.text: He loved exciting stories and often forgot what had happened yesterday. The other children began to forget parts of their old home, too. Wendy asked them questions about their parents so they would remember.

sentences.en: He loved exciting stories and often forgot what had happened yesterday.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢精彩的故事，却常常忘记昨天发生的事。

sentences.en: The other children began to forget parts of their old home, too.
sentences.zh: 其他孩子也开始忘记以前家里的一些事情。

sentences.en: Wendy asked them questions about their parents so they would remember.
sentences.zh: 温蒂会问他们有关父母的问题，帮助他们记住。

picturePages.text: At night, she wondered whether her mother was still waiting. Outside, the island was beautiful, but it was never completely safe. The pirates were looking for Peter and the Lost Boys.

sentences.en: At night, she wondered whether her mother was still waiting.
sentences.zh: 夜里，她会想，妈妈是不是还在等着他们。

sentences.en: Outside, the island was beautiful, but it was never completely safe.
sentences.zh: 外面的岛很美，却从来不是完全安全的。

sentences.en: The pirates were looking for Peter and the Lost Boys.
sentences.zh: 海盗们正在寻找彼得和迷失男孩们。

picturePages.text: Their captain wanted revenge.

sentences.en: Their captain wanted revenge.
sentences.zh: 他们的船长一心想报仇。

picturePages.text: Chapter 5: The Captain and the Clock. Captain Hook had a sharp metal hook instead of one hand. Peter had cut off that hand during an earlier fight.

sentences.en: Chapter 5: The Captain and the Clock.
sentences.zh: 第5章：船长与时钟。

sentences.en: Captain Hook had a sharp metal hook instead of one hand.
sentences.zh: 胡克船长的一只手被尖锐的金属钩取代了。

sentences.en: Peter had cut off that hand during an earlier fight.
sentences.zh: 在以前的一次战斗中，彼得砍掉了那只手。

picturePages.text: A crocodile had eaten it and wanted to catch Hook again. The crocodile had also swallowed a clock. Its ticking sound warned Hook whenever it came near.

sentences.en: A crocodile had eaten it and wanted to catch Hook again.
sentences.zh: 一条鳄鱼吃掉了那只手，还想再次抓住胡克。

sentences.en: The crocodile had also swallowed a clock.
sentences.zh: 那条鳄鱼还吞下了一只时钟。

sentences.en: Its ticking sound warned Hook whenever it came near.
sentences.zh: 每当鳄鱼靠近，滴答声就会提醒胡克。

picturePages.text: The captain feared that sound more than any sword. But one day the clock might stop. Then the crocodile could come without a warning.

sentences.en: The captain feared that sound more than any sword.
sentences.zh: 比起任何一把剑，船长更害怕那个声音。

sentences.en: But one day the clock might stop.
sentences.zh: 可是，有一天时钟也许会停下来。

sentences.en: Then the crocodile could come without a warning.
sentences.zh: 那时，鳄鱼就能悄无声息地靠近。

picturePages.text: Hook was proud of his fine coat and careful manners. He wanted people to think he was better than everyone else. Peter's laughter made him furious.

sentences.en: Hook was proud of his fine coat and careful manners.
sentences.zh: 胡克很为自己的漂亮外套和讲究的礼仪自豪。

sentences.en: He wanted people to think he was better than everyone else.
sentences.zh: 他希望别人认为他比所有人都高贵。

sentences.en: Peter's laughter made him furious.
sentences.zh: 彼得的笑声让他暴怒。

picturePages.text: With his pirate Smee, Hook searched the forest for the secret home. They found the trees with holes inside them. Hook began making a plan to catch the children.

sentences.en: With his pirate Smee, Hook searched the forest for the secret home.
sentences.zh: 胡克和海盗斯密一起，在森林里寻找那个秘密的家。

sentences.en: They found the trees with holes inside them.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了里面有洞的树。

sentences.en: Hook began making a plan to catch the children.
sentences.zh: 胡克开始计划怎样抓住孩子们。

picturePages.text: Suddenly, a slow ticking came through the trees. Hook forgot his plan and ran away. Peter was not the only danger waiting for him on the island.

sentences.en: Suddenly, a slow ticking came through the trees.
sentences.zh: 突然，树林里传来了缓慢的滴答声。

sentences.en: Hook forgot his plan and ran away.
sentences.zh: 胡克忘了自己的计划，转身逃跑。

sentences.en: Peter was not the only danger waiting for him on the island.
sentences.zh: 在这座岛上，等待他的危险不只有彼得。

picturePages.text: Chapter 6: The Rising Water. One day, Peter and Wendy visited the mermaids' lake. The mermaids played in the water but were not kind to Wendy.

sentences.en: Chapter 6: The Rising Water.
sentences.zh: 第6章：上涨的海水。

sentences.en: One day, Peter and Wendy visited the mermaids' lake.
sentences.zh: 一天，彼得和温蒂来到了美人鱼居住的湖边。

sentences.en: The mermaids played in the water but were not kind to Wendy.
sentences.zh: 美人鱼们在水里嬉戏，却对温蒂并不友善。

picturePages.text: Soon a pirate boat arrived with Tiger Lily tied inside it. She belonged to a community that lived on the island. The pirates left her on a rock as the water rose.

sentences.en: Soon a pirate boat arrived with Tiger Lily tied inside it.
sentences.zh: 不久，一艘海盗小船驶来，虎莲被绑在船里。

sentences.en: She belonged to a community that lived on the island.
sentences.zh: 她来自岛上的一个族群。

sentences.en: The pirates left her on a rock as the water rose.
sentences.zh: 海水上涨时，海盗把她留在了一块礁石上。

picturePages.text: Peter hid nearby and copied Hook's voice. He ordered the pirates to let Tiger Lily go. They were afraid to argue with their captain, so they obeyed.

sentences.en: Peter hid nearby and copied Hook's voice.
sentences.zh: 彼得躲在附近，模仿胡克的声音。

sentences.en: He ordered the pirates to let Tiger Lily go.
sentences.zh: 他命令海盗放走虎莲。

sentences.en: They were afraid to argue with their captain, so they obeyed.
sentences.zh: 他们不敢和船长争辩，于是照做了。

picturePages.text: Then the real Hook arrived, and a fight began. Peter was hurt while trying to fight fairly. The water kept rising, and Wendy could not fly away.

sentences.en: Then the real Hook arrived, and a fight began.
sentences.zh: 随后，真正的胡克赶到了，一场战斗开始了。

sentences.en: Peter was hurt while trying to fight fairly.
sentences.zh: 彼得想公平地战斗，却因此受了伤。

sentences.en: The water kept rising, and Wendy could not fly away.
sentences.zh: 海水不断上涨，温蒂也没法飞走。

picturePages.text: Peter helped her escape on a large kite. He stayed behind on the rock as the sea covered it. For once, there was no easy game that could save him.

sentences.en: Peter helped her escape on a large kite.
sentences.zh: 彼得帮助她乘着一只大风筝逃走了。

sentences.en: He stayed behind on the rock as the sea covered it.
sentences.zh: 他留在礁石上，海水渐渐淹过了石头。

sentences.en: For once, there was no easy game that could save him.
sentences.zh: 这一次，没有哪个轻松的游戏能救他。

picturePages.text: A bird saw him and pushed her floating nest toward him. Peter moved the bird's eggs into a hat to keep them safe. Then he climbed into the nest and floated away.

sentences.en: A bird saw him and pushed her floating nest toward him.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟看见了他，把漂浮的巢推向他。

sentences.en: Peter moved the bird's eggs into a hat to keep them safe.
sentences.zh: 彼得把鸟蛋移到帽子里，保护好它们。

sentences.en: Then he climbed into the nest and floated away.
sentences.zh: 然后，他爬进鸟巢，漂向安全的地方。

picturePages.text: That night, Wendy was grateful to see him come home.

sentences.en: That night, Wendy was grateful to see him come home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，温蒂看到他回家，满心感激。

picturePages.text: Chapter 7: Wendy's Choice. Wendy told the boys a story about three children who flew away. In the story, their mother kept the window open until they returned.

sentences.en: Chapter 7: Wendy's Choice.
sentences.zh: 第7章：温蒂的选择。

sentences.en: Wendy told the boys a story about three children who flew away.
sentences.zh: 温蒂给男孩们讲了三个孩子飞离家园的故事。

sentences.en: In the story, their mother kept the window open until they returned.
sentences.zh: 在故事里，他们的妈妈一直开着窗，等他们回来。

picturePages.text: The boys liked this happy ending, but Peter grew quiet. He said that he had once gone back to his own home. He believed the window was closed and another child was in his bed.

sentences.en: The boys liked this happy ending, but Peter grew quiet.
sentences.zh: 男孩们喜欢这个快乐的结局，彼得却沉默了。

sentences.en: He said that he had once gone back to his own home.
sentences.zh: 他说，他也曾回到自己的家。

sentences.en: He believed the window was closed and another child was in his bed.
sentences.zh: 他认为窗户已经关上，自己的床上睡着另一个孩子。

picturePages.text: No one knew whether his memory was right. But Wendy understood that Peter was afraid of being forgotten. She suddenly wanted to see her parents.

sentences.en: No one knew whether his memory was right.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道他的记忆是否准确。

sentences.en: But Wendy understood that Peter was afraid of being forgotten.
sentences.zh: 但温蒂明白了，彼得害怕被遗忘。

sentences.en: She suddenly wanted to see her parents.
sentences.zh: 她突然很想见到父母。

picturePages.text: John and Michael wanted to go home, too. The Lost Boys feared losing Wendy and asked her to stay. She offered to take them home and find them a family.

sentences.en: John and Michael wanted to go home, too.
sentences.zh: 约翰和迈克尔也想回家。

sentences.en: The Lost Boys feared losing Wendy and asked her to stay.
sentences.zh: 迷失男孩们害怕失去温蒂，请求她留下。

sentences.en: She offered to take them home and find them a family.
sentences.zh: 她提出带他们回家，让他们也拥有一个家庭。

picturePages.text: Peter acted as if he did not care, but he was unhappy. Some boys wanted to stop Wendy from leaving. Peter would not keep her against her wishes.

sentences.en: Peter acted as if he did not care, but he was unhappy.
sentences.zh: 彼得装作不在乎，其实很不高兴。

sentences.en: Some boys wanted to stop Wendy from leaving.
sentences.zh: 有些男孩想阻止温蒂离开。

sentences.en: Peter would not keep her against her wishes.
sentences.zh: 彼得不肯违背她的意愿，把她留住。

picturePages.text: The children prepared for their journey and said goodbye. They climbed out through the trees while Peter stayed below. Above them, the pirates were waiting in the dark.

sentences.en: The children prepared for their journey and said goodbye.
sentences.zh: 孩子们准备好行装，互相告别。

sentences.en: They climbed out through the trees while Peter stayed below.
sentences.zh: 他们沿着树洞爬出去，彼得留在地下。

sentences.en: Above them, the pirates were waiting in the dark.
sentences.zh: 在他们头顶上，海盗们正在黑暗中等候。

picturePages.text: The journey home had become a trap.

sentences.en: The journey home had become a trap.
sentences.zh: 回家的路已经变成了一个陷阱。

picturePages.text: Chapter 8: A Small Light. The pirates attacked the island guards and caught the children. They tied Wendy and the boys and carried them to the ship.

sentences.en: Chapter 8: A Small Light.
sentences.zh: 第8章：一点微光。

sentences.en: The pirates attacked the island guards and caught the children.
sentences.zh: 海盗袭击了岛上的守卫，抓住了孩子们。

sentences.en: They tied Wendy and the boys and carried them to the ship.
sentences.zh: 他们捆住温蒂和男孩们，把他们带上了船。

picturePages.text: Below the ground, Peter was still asleep. Hook climbed down into the secret home without making a sound. He put poison into Peter's cup of medicine and slipped away.

sentences.en: Below the ground, Peter was still asleep.
sentences.zh: 在地下，彼得仍然睡着。

sentences.en: Hook climbed down into the secret home without making a sound.
sentences.zh: 胡克悄无声息地爬进了秘密的家。

sentences.en: He put poison into Peter's cup of medicine and slipped away.
sentences.zh: 他在彼得的药杯里下了毒，然后偷偷离开。

picturePages.text: Tinker Bell returned and woke Peter. She told him what had happened to the children. Peter reached for his medicine before going to save them.

sentences.en: Tinker Bell returned and woke Peter.
sentences.zh: 叮当回来，叫醒了彼得。

sentences.en: She told him what had happened to the children.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了他孩子们的遭遇。

sentences.en: Peter reached for his medicine before going to save them.
sentences.zh: 彼得准备去救他们，伸手想先喝掉药。

picturePages.text: Tinker Bell warned him, but he did not believe her. Before he could drink, she drank the poison herself. Her bright light became weak, and she fell beside him.

sentences.en: Tinker Bell warned him, but he did not believe her.
sentences.zh: 叮当警告了他，但他没有相信。

sentences.en: Before he could drink, she drank the poison herself.
sentences.zh: 在他喝下去之前，她自己喝掉了毒药。

sentences.en: Her bright light became weak, and she fell beside him.
sentences.zh: 她明亮的光变得微弱，倒在了他的身边。

picturePages.text: Peter finally understood what she had done for him. She said she could live if children still believed in fairies. Peter called into the night for anyone who could hear him.

sentences.en: Peter finally understood what she had done for him.
sentences.zh: 彼得终于明白，她为自己做了什么。

sentences.en: She said she could live if children still believed in fairies.
sentences.zh: 她说，只要孩子们仍然相信仙女，她就能够活下来。

sentences.en: Peter called into the night for anyone who could hear him.
sentences.zh: 彼得向夜空呼喊，希望有人能听见。

picturePages.text: Far away, children clapped their hands to show their belief. Tinker Bell's light slowly became bright again. Peter thanked her, then took his sword.

sentences.en: Far away, children clapped their hands to show their belief.
sentences.zh: 在远方，孩子们拍起手，表达他们的相信。

sentences.en: Tinker Bell's light slowly became bright again.
sentences.zh: 叮当的光渐渐重新亮了起来。

sentences.en: Peter thanked her, then took his sword.
sentences.zh: 彼得感谢了她，然后拿起了剑。

picturePages.text: Together, they flew toward the pirate ship.

sentences.en: Together, they flew toward the pirate ship.
sentences.zh: 他们一起飞向海盗船。

picturePages.text: Chapter 9: The Ship in the Dark. On the ship, Hook asked the boys to join his crew. They refused, so he ordered them to walk off a narrow board into the sea.

sentences.en: Chapter 9: The Ship in the Dark.
sentences.zh: 第9章：黑暗中的船。

sentences.en: On the ship, Hook asked the boys to join his crew.
sentences.zh: 在船上，胡克要男孩们加入他的船员队伍。

sentences.en: They refused, so he ordered them to walk off a narrow board into the sea.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝了，于是他命令他们沿着狭窄的木板走入海里。

picturePages.text: Wendy told them to be brave, although she was afraid herself. Then a ticking sound came over the water. Hook thought the crocodile was near and hid in fear.

sentences.en: Wendy told them to be brave, although she was afraid herself.
sentences.zh: 温蒂叫他们勇敢起来，尽管她自己也很害怕。

sentences.en: Then a ticking sound came over the water.
sentences.zh: 这时，水面上传来了滴答声。

sentences.en: Hook thought the crocodile was near and hid in fear.
sentences.zh: 胡克以为鳄鱼来了，吓得躲了起来。

picturePages.text: But it was Peter, copying the sound of the clock. He climbed onto the ship while the pirates were confused. He slipped into a dark room below the deck.

sentences.en: But it was Peter, copying the sound of the clock.
sentences.zh: 其实是彼得在模仿时钟的声音。

sentences.en: He climbed onto the ship while the pirates were confused.
sentences.zh: 趁着海盗们慌乱，他爬上了船。

sentences.en: He slipped into a dark room below the deck.
sentences.zh: 他悄悄走进甲板下面的一间黑屋子。

picturePages.text: One pirate entered the room and did not come back. The other pirates became afraid of something they could not see. Peter reached the children and quietly cut their ropes.

sentences.en: One pirate entered the room and did not come back.
sentences.zh: 一个海盗走进了房间，却没有回来。

sentences.en: The other pirates became afraid of something they could not see.
sentences.zh: 其他海盗开始害怕那看不见的东西。

sentences.en: Peter reached the children and quietly cut their ropes.
sentences.zh: 彼得找到孩子们，悄悄割断了他们的绳子。

picturePages.text: They hid while he went to find Hook. Wendy waited for a sign that it was safe to move. She knew that being quiet could matter as much as fighting.

sentences.en: They hid while he went to find Hook.
sentences.zh: 他们躲了起来，彼得则去寻找胡克。

sentences.en: Wendy waited for a sign that it was safe to move.
sentences.zh: 温蒂等着，想知道什么时候行动才安全。

sentences.en: She knew that being quiet could matter as much as fighting.
sentences.zh: 她知道，保持安静有时和战斗一样重要。

picturePages.text: At last, Peter stood in front of the captain. There was no more hiding and no more ticking trick. Hook raised his sword, and Peter raised his own.

sentences.en: At last, Peter stood in front of the captain.
sentences.zh: 终于，彼得站到了船长面前。

sentences.en: There was no more hiding and no more ticking trick.
sentences.zh: 这次不再有藏身之处，也不再有滴答声的计谋。

sentences.en: Hook raised his sword, and Peter raised his own.
sentences.zh: 胡克举起剑，彼得也举起了自己的剑。

picturePages.text: Chapter 10: Hook or Peter. The two enemies fought across the deck. Hook was strong and knew many cruel tricks.

sentences.en: Chapter 10: Hook or Peter.
sentences.zh: 第10章：胡克还是彼得。

sentences.en: The two enemies fought across the deck.
sentences.zh: 两个敌人在甲板上交战。

sentences.en: Hook was strong and knew many cruel tricks.
sentences.zh: 胡克力气很大，懂得许多残忍的招数。

picturePages.text: Peter was quick and could fly out of danger. When Hook lost his sword, Peter let him pick it up. This made the proud captain even more angry.

sentences.en: Peter was quick and could fly out of danger.
sentences.zh: 彼得动作敏捷，可以飞离危险。

sentences.en: When Hook lost his sword, Peter let him pick it up.
sentences.zh: 胡克的剑掉了时，彼得让他重新捡起来。

sentences.en: This made the proud captain even more angry.
sentences.zh: 这让骄傲的船长更加愤怒。

picturePages.text: He could not bear kindness from the boy he hated. Around them, the children fought the other pirates. Soon Peter and his friends were winning.

sentences.en: He could not bear kindness from the boy he hated.
sentences.zh: 他无法忍受自己痛恨的男孩对自己表现出善意。

sentences.en: Around them, the children fought the other pirates.
sentences.zh: 在他们周围，孩子们和其他海盗交战。

sentences.en: Soon Peter and his friends were winning.
sentences.zh: 不久，彼得和朋友们占了上风。

picturePages.text: Hook tried one last trick, but Peter stopped him. The captain jumped from the ship into the sea. The crocodile was waiting below.

sentences.en: Hook tried one last trick, but Peter stopped him.
sentences.zh: 胡克使出了最后一个诡计，但彼得阻止了他。

sentences.en: The captain jumped from the ship into the sea.
sentences.zh: 船长从船上跳进了海里。

sentences.en: The crocodile was waiting below.
sentences.zh: 鳄鱼正在下面等着他。

picturePages.text: Hook never came back. Peter put on the captain's coat and began giving orders. For a moment, he looked very pleased to have power.

sentences.en: Hook never came back.
sentences.zh: 胡克再也没有回来。

sentences.en: Peter put on the captain's coat and began giving orders.
sentences.zh: 彼得穿上船长的外套，开始发号施令。

sentences.en: For a moment, he looked very pleased to have power.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，他看起来很享受掌握权力的感觉。

picturePages.text: Wendy reminded him that they still had a journey to finish. The children set the ship's course toward home. The adventure was ending, but Wendy's biggest choice was still ahead.

sentences.en: Wendy reminded him that they still had a journey to finish.
sentences.zh: 温蒂提醒他，他们还有一段旅程没有完成。

sentences.en: The children set the ship's course toward home.
sentences.zh: 孩子们让船朝着家的方向驶去。

sentences.en: The adventure was ending, but Wendy's biggest choice was still ahead.
sentences.zh: 冒险快结束了，但温蒂最重要的选择还在前方。

picturePages.text: Chapter 11: The Way Home. Peter reached the Darling house before the other children. He thought about closing the bedroom window.

sentences.en: Chapter 11: The Way Home.
sentences.zh: 第11章：回家的路。

sentences.en: Peter reached the Darling house before the other children.
sentences.zh: 彼得比其他孩子先到达达林家。

sentences.en: He thought about closing the bedroom window.
sentences.zh: 他想过把卧室窗户关上。

picturePages.text: If Wendy thought her mother had forgotten her, she might return to Neverland. Then Peter saw Mrs Darling sitting beside the empty beds. She looked sad and was still waiting for her children.

sentences.en: If Wendy thought her mother had forgotten her, she might return to Neverland.
sentences.zh: 如果温蒂以为妈妈忘了她，她也许就会回到梦幻岛。

sentences.en: Then Peter saw Mrs Darling sitting beside the empty beds.
sentences.zh: 这时，彼得看见达林太太坐在空床旁。

sentences.en: She looked sad and was still waiting for her children.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很伤心，仍然在等自己的孩子。

picturePages.text: Peter changed his mind and left the window open. Wendy, John, and Michael flew in and climbed into their beds. At first, their mother thought she was dreaming.

sentences.zh: 彼得改变了主意，让窗户继续开着。

sentences.en: Wendy, John, and Michael flew in and climbed into their beds.
sentences.zh: 温蒂、约翰和迈克尔飞了进来，爬上自己的床。

sentences.en: At first, their mother thought she was dreaming.
sentences.zh: 起初，他们的妈妈以为自己在做梦。

picturePages.text: Then she heard their voices and held them in her arms. Mr Darling and Nana came running into the room. The Lost Boys waited nearby, hoping there would be room for them.

sentences.en: Then she heard their voices and held them in her arms.
sentences.zh: 随后，她听见他们的声音，把他们抱进怀里。

sentences.en: Mr Darling and Nana came running into the room.
sentences.zh: 达林先生和娜娜也跑进了房间。

sentences.en: The Lost Boys waited nearby, hoping there would be room for them.
sentences.zh: 迷失男孩们在附近等待，希望这个家也能容纳他们。

picturePages.text: The Darlings welcomed them into the family. Mrs Darling offered Peter a home, too. But Peter asked whether he would have to go to school and grow up.

sentences.en: The Darlings welcomed them into the family.
sentences.zh: 达林夫妇欢迎他们成为家里的一员。

sentences.en: Mrs Darling offered Peter a home, too.
sentences.zh: 达林太太也邀请彼得住下来。

sentences.en: But Peter asked whether he would have to go to school and grow up.
sentences.zh: 但彼得问，自己是不是得去上学、长大。

picturePages.text: When she said yes, he refused. Wendy wanted to stay with her family, even though she loved flying. Peter promised to return for her again.

sentences.en: When she said yes, he refused.
sentences.zh: 当她说是的时候，他拒绝了。

sentences.en: Wendy wanted to stay with her family, even though she loved flying.
sentences.zh: 温蒂想和家人留在一起，尽管她也热爱飞行。

sentences.en: Peter promised to return for her again.
sentences.zh: 彼得答应会再次回来找她。

picturePages.text: He flew away, leaving Wendy beside the open window.

sentences.en: He flew away, leaving Wendy beside the open window.
sentences.zh: 他飞走了，留下温蒂站在打开的窗户旁。

picturePages.text: Chapter 12: When Wendy Grew Up. The Lost Boys went to school and slowly became part of ordinary life. Wendy grew older with her brothers.

sentences.en: Chapter 12: When Wendy Grew Up.
sentences.zh: 第12章：温蒂长大以后。

sentences.en: The Lost Boys went to school and slowly became part of ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 迷失男孩们上了学，慢慢融入了普通人的生活。

sentences.en: Wendy grew older with her brothers.
sentences.zh: 温蒂和弟弟们一起长大。

picturePages.text: Peter sometimes returned, but he did not come every year. For him, one adventure quickly replaced another. Wendy remembered things that Peter had already forgotten.

sentences.en: Peter sometimes returned, but he did not come every year.
sentences.zh: 彼得有时会回来，但并不是每年都来。

sentences.en: For him, one adventure quickly replaced another.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，一场冒险很快就会被另一场取代。

sentences.en: Wendy remembered things that Peter had already forgotten.
sentences.zh: 温蒂还记得的事情，彼得却已经忘记了。

picturePages.text: One day, Wendy was grown up and had a daughter called Jane. She told Jane stories about Neverland and the boy who could fly. Then Peter came through the window again.

sentences.en: One day, Wendy was grown up and had a daughter called Jane.
sentences.zh: 后来，温蒂长大了，有了一个叫简的女儿。

sentences.en: She told Jane stories about Neverland and the boy who could fly.
sentences.zh: 她给简讲梦幻岛和那个会飞的男孩的故事。

sentences.en: Then Peter came through the window again.
sentences.zh: 这时，彼得又一次从窗户飞了进来。

picturePages.text: He was still a boy, but Wendy was no longer a child. Peter did not understand how so much time could have passed. He sat on the floor and cried.

sentences.en: He was still a boy, but Wendy was no longer a child.
sentences.zh: 他仍然是个男孩，但温蒂已经不再是孩子。

sentences.en: Peter did not understand how so much time could have passed.
sentences.zh: 彼得不明白，为什么时间已经过去了这么久。

sentences.en: He sat on the floor and cried.
sentences.zh: 他坐在地板上哭了起来。

picturePages.text: Jane woke up and asked him what was wrong. Soon Peter was teaching her to fly. Wendy let Jane visit Neverland for a little while.

sentences.en: Jane woke up and asked him what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 简醒来，问他怎么了。

sentences.en: Soon Peter was teaching her to fly.
sentences.zh: 很快，彼得开始教她飞行。

sentences.en: Wendy let Jane visit Neverland for a little while.
sentences.zh: 温蒂允许简去梦幻岛待一小段时间。

picturePages.text: She could no longer fly with Peter, but she could still love the story. Later, Jane would tell it to her own daughter. Peter's adventures would begin again, with another child beside him.

sentences.en: She could no longer fly with Peter, but she could still love the story.
sentences.zh: 她已经不能再和彼得一起飞，但她仍然可以热爱这个故事。

sentences.en: Later, Jane would tell it to her own daughter.
sentences.zh: 以后，简也会把它讲给自己的女儿听。

sentences.en: Peter's adventures would begin again, with another child beside him.
sentences.zh: 彼得的冒险还会重新开始，身旁陪着另一个孩子。

picturePages.text: Wendy's adventure had changed her, and she carried it into the life she chose.

sentences.en: Wendy's adventure had changed her, and she carried it into the life she chose.
sentences.zh: 温蒂的冒险改变了她，她把这段经历带进了自己选择的人生。

paragraphs: Peter Pan.
Chapter 1: The Open Window. Wendy Darling lived in London with her brothers, John and Michael. Their dog, Nana, helped look after them.
At night, Wendy told stories about a boy called Peter Pan. He could fly, and he did not want to grow up. One night, Peter came through the bedroom window.
A tiny fairy called Tinker Bell came with him. Peter was looking for his shadow. Nana had caught it when he visited the room before.
He found it, but he could not join it to his feet. Wendy woke up and saw him crying on the floor. She carefully sewed his shadow back on.
Peter jumped up and said that he had done it himself. Wendy was hurt, and he quickly tried to make her smile. They gave each other small gifts.
Peter gave Wendy an acorn button, which she wore on a chain. Then he told her about an island called Neverland. The Lost Boys lived there, but they had no one to tell them stories.
Peter asked Wendy to come with him.
Chapter 2: Across the Night Sky. Wendy wanted an adventure, but she would not leave her brothers behind. Peter agreed to take all three children.
He taught them to think happy thoughts. Tinker Bell gave them fairy dust, and their feet left the floor. Soon they were flying above the roofs of London.
The streets below looked like thin lines of light. Wendy felt excited when the city disappeared behind them. They flew over the sea for a long time.
The children became tired and hungry, but Peter kept playing. Sometimes he flew away and almost forgot to come back. Wendy began to see that flying was easier for him than caring for others.
At last, dark trees and bright water appeared below. There were mountains, a small lake, and a pirate ship. The island looked like a dream that had become real.
Then a gun fired from the ship. The children rushed into the clouds and lost sight of one another. Tinker Bell offered to guide Wendy to a safe place.
Wendy followed her little light toward the trees.
Chapter 3: The Arrow in the Forest. Tinker Bell was jealous because Peter liked talking to Wendy. She flew ahead and found the Lost Boys.
She told them that Peter wanted them to shoot the strange flying girl. One boy, Tootles, believed her and let an arrow fly. Wendy fell to the ground, and the boys hurried toward her.
When Peter arrived, he was angry and afraid. Then he saw the acorn button hanging from Wendy's chain. The arrow had struck the button instead of her heart.
Wendy was alive, and she slowly opened her eyes. Tootles was sorry and offered Peter his life. Wendy stopped Peter from hurting him.
Peter sent Tinker Bell away for a time because of her cruel trick. The boys built a small house around Wendy while she rested. They hoped that she would stay and look after them.
Wendy said she was only a girl and did not know much about being a mother. The boys said that she already knew more than they did. Peter stood outside with his sword and kept watch.
For that night, Wendy and her brothers were safe.
Chapter 4: A Home Under the Ground. The children moved into a secret home under the ground. Each boy climbed down through a hole inside a tree.
There was a table, a warm fire, and a large bed. Tinker Bell had a tiny room of her own. Wendy told stories and helped the boys mend their clothes.
John and Michael joined the games and quickly felt at home. Sometimes the children pretended to have a wonderful dinner. Peter enjoyed the game even when there was little real food.
He called himself their father, but he meant it only as a game. Wendy sometimes wished he could understand her feelings more clearly. Peter was brave and full of ideas, but he could be careless.

He loved exciting stories and often forgot what had happened yesterday. The other children began to forget parts of their old home, too. Wendy asked them questions about their parents so they would remember.
At night, she wondered whether her mother was still waiting. Outside, the island was beautiful, but it was never completely safe. The pirates were looking for Peter and the Lost Boys.
Their captain wanted revenge.
Chapter 5: The Captain and the Clock. Captain Hook had a sharp metal hook instead of one hand. Peter had cut off that hand during an earlier fight.
A crocodile had eaten it and wanted to catch Hook again. The crocodile had also swallowed a clock. Its ticking sound warned Hook whenever it came near.
The captain feared that sound more than any sword. But one day the clock might stop. Then the crocodile could come without a warning.
Hook was proud of his fine coat and careful manners. He wanted people to think he was better than everyone else. Peter's laughter made him furious.
With his pirate Smee, Hook searched the forest for the secret home. They found the trees with holes inside them. Hook began making a plan to catch the children.
Suddenly, a slow ticking came through the trees. Hook forgot his plan and ran away. Peter was not the only danger waiting for him on the island.
Chapter 6: The Rising Water. One day, Peter and Wendy visited the mermaids' lake. The mermaids played in the water but were not kind to Wendy.
Soon a pirate boat arrived with Tiger Lily tied inside it. She belonged to a community that lived on the island. The pirates left her on a rock as the water rose.
Peter hid nearby and copied Hook's voice. He ordered the pirates to let Tiger Lily go. They were afraid to argue with their captain, so they obeyed.
Then the real Hook arrived, and a fight began. Peter was hurt while trying to fight fairly. The water kept rising, and Wendy could not fly away.
Peter helped her escape on a large kite. He stayed behind on the rock as the sea covered it. For once, there was no easy game that could save him.
A bird saw him and pushed her floating nest toward him. Peter moved the bird's eggs into a hat to keep them safe. Then he climbed into the nest and floated away.
That night, Wendy was grateful to see him come home.
Chapter 7: Wendy's Choice. Wendy told the boys a story about three children who flew away. In the story, their mother kept the window open until they returned.
The boys liked this happy ending, but Peter grew quiet. He said that he had once gone back to his own home. He believed the window was closed and another child was in his bed.
No one knew whether his memory was right. But Wendy understood that Peter was afraid of being forgotten. She suddenly wanted to see her parents.
John and Michael wanted to go home, too. The Lost Boys feared losing Wendy and asked her to stay. She offered to take them home and find them a family.
Peter acted as if he did not care, but he was unhappy. Some boys wanted to stop Wendy from leaving. Peter would not keep her against her wishes.
The children prepared for their journey and said goodbye. They climbed out through the trees while Peter stayed below. Above them, the pirates were waiting in the dark.
The journey home had become a trap.
Chapter 8: A Small Light. The pirates attacked the island guards and caught the children. They tied Wendy and the boys and carried them to the ship.
Below the ground, Peter was still asleep. Hook climbed down into the secret home without making a sound. He put poison into Peter's cup of medicine and slipped away.
Tinker Bell returned and woke Peter. She told him what had happened to the children. Peter reached for his medicine before going to save them.
Tinker Bell warned him, but he did not believe her. Before he could drink, she drank the poison herself. Her bright light became weak, and she fell beside him.
Peter finally understood what she had done for him. She said she could live if children still believed in fairies. Peter called into the night for anyone who could hear him.
Far away, children clapped their hands to show their belief. Tinker Bell's light slowly became bright again. Peter thanked her, then took his sword.
Together, they flew toward the pirate ship.
Chapter 9: The Ship in the Dark. On the ship, Hook asked the boys to join his crew. They refused, so he ordered them to walk off a narrow board into the sea.
Wendy told them to be brave, although she was afraid herself. Then a ticking sound came over the water. Hook thought the crocodile was near and hid in fear.
But it was Peter, copying the sound of the clock. He climbed onto the ship while the pirates were confused. He slipped into a dark room below the deck.
One pirate entered the room and did not come back. The other pirates became afraid of something they could not see. Peter reached the children and quietly cut their ropes.
They hid while he went to find Hook. Wendy waited for a sign that it was safe to move. She knew that being quiet could matter as much as fighting.
At last, Peter stood in front of the captain. There was no more hiding and no more ticking trick. Hook raised his sword, and Peter raised his own.
Chapter 10: Hook or Peter. The two enemies fought across the deck. Hook was strong and knew many cruel tricks.
Peter was quick and could fly out of danger. When Hook lost his sword, Peter let him pick it up. This made the proud captain even more angry.
He could not bear kindness from the boy he hated. Around them, the children fought the other pirates. Soon Peter and his friends were winning.
Hook tried one last trick, but Peter stopped him. The captain jumped from the ship into the sea. The crocodile was waiting below.
Hook never came back. Peter put on the captain's coat and began giving orders. For a moment, he looked very pleased to have power.
Wendy reminded him that they still had a journey to finish. The children set the ship's course toward home. The adventure was ending, but Wendy's biggest choice was still ahead.
Chapter 11: The Way Home. Peter reached the Darling house before the other children. He thought about closing the bedroom window.
If Wendy thought her mother had forgotten her, she might return to Neverland. Then Peter saw Mrs Darling sitting beside the empty beds. She looked sad and was still waiting for her children.
Peter changed his mind and left the window open. Wendy, John, and Michael flew in and climbed into their beds. At first, their mother thought she was dreaming.
Then she heard their voices and held them in her arms. Mr Darling and Nana came running into the room. The Lost Boys waited nearby, hoping there would be room for them.
The Darlings welcomed them into the family. Mrs Darling offered Peter a home, too. But Peter asked whether he would have to go to school and grow up.
When she said yes, he refused. Wendy wanted to stay with her family, even though she loved flying. Peter promised to return for her again.
He flew away, leaving Wendy beside the open window.
Chapter 12: When Wendy Grew Up. The Lost Boys went to school and slowly became part of ordinary life. Wendy grew older with her brothers.
Peter sometimes returned, but he did not come every year. For him, one adventure quickly replaced another. Wendy remembered things that Peter had already forgotten.
One day, Wendy was grown up and had a daughter called Jane. She told Jane stories about Neverland and the boy who could fly. Then Peter came through the window again.
He was still a boy, but Wendy was no longer a child. Peter did not understand how so much time could have passed. He sat on the floor and cried.
Jane woke up and asked him what was wrong. Soon Peter was teaching her to fly. Wendy let Jane visit Neverland for a little while.
She could no longer fly with Peter, but she could still love the story. Later, Jane would tell it to her own daughter. Peter's adventures would begin again, with another child beside him.
Wendy's adventure had changed her, and she carried it into the life she chose.
